description: Fetch a workflow run's metadata + status. Mirrors GET /api/v2/repos/.../actions/runs/:id. Also says how it relates to automatic retries: `retryOf` / `retryOfRunNumber` (the run this one retries after a deploy or a lost runner) and `retriedAs` ({id, runNumber} of the run that retried this one, or null). A queued run that no runner can take carries `queueReason` (e.g. "waiting for a runner: 2 configured, 0 reachable, last seen 4m ago"). `workClass` (interactive / review / push / schedule — how the CI claim shares slots); a queued run carries `queue` ({code, text}: its place in the claim order, from the claim plan itself); a schedule run carries `coalescedFires` / `lastCoalescedAt`, and `coalescedNote` when later scheduled fires folded into it while it was queued.

run_id.description: The run's id, or a unique leading part of it (8+ hex characters)

name: gluecron_get_workflow_run
